requirements.text: Add regression_repair as a typed strict-plan maintenance mode; do not create a free-form repair lane or allow ordinary Quick Dev to consume it.
Preserve backward compatibility by normalizing contracts without an explicit maintenance mode to implementation.
Require the parent Quick Dev router to validate and project maintenanceMode before the adapter reads plan state or creates evidence.
For regression repair, validate RED by exact selector, expected failure IDs, typed failure class and nonzero exit rather than by exit code alone.
Capture bounded stdout and stderr observations with hashes and redaction metadata so failure identity can be verified without persisting unbounded or secret output.
Compute, persist and accumulate a deterministic failure fingerprint and stop repeated identical repair attempts at the declared threshold.
Require a historical-log search for the same failure family before a regression repair write, while keeping historical matches non-authorizing.
Require reading the failing source implementation and at least one real callsite before a repair hypothesis is accepted.
Require a bounded complete investigation closure covering direct consumers, existing tests and dependency files, and map every observed error to at least one newly read evidence file.
Prefer adding regression cases to existing test files; a new test file requires an explicit machine-readable no-existing-test reason.
Reject speculative repairs whose hypothesis is not bound to current failure evidence, source evidence, callsite evidence and a targeted test.
For Phase service repair scope, require the relevant Phase test or smoke command route and explicit approval before protected Phase paths may be written.
Preserve failed observations and historical evidence append-only; add sidecars instead of rewriting prior failures.
Keep implementation-complete owned by Quick Dev and acceptance-passed owned by Refactor Acceptance; repair evidence cannot authorize acceptance, commit, release or archive.
Preserve the active plan-delivery-loop plan as a read-only compatibility consumer and do not modify or absorb its current worktree changes.

acceptance.assertion: Both canonical and plan-owned implementation-contract schemas admit only implementation or regression_repair maintenance modes.
A regression_repair contract remains in strict_tdd_plan and no new lane or Stock BMAD fallback is introduced.
Existing schema-valid contracts without maintenance_mode route as implementation with unchanged backend selection.
The parent router output includes normalized maintenanceMode and validates the referenced regression repair contract before handoff.
Direct adapter entry without a successful parent route fails before run evidence or BMAD artifacts are created.
A nonzero RED with the wrong selector, missing expected ID or unrelated failure class is rejected.
Assertion, compile, harness, timeout, infrastructure and unexpected-pass observations are distinguished by a closed typed classification.
Stage observation retains bounded stdout/stderr bytes or excerpts, total byte counts, truncation flags and SHA-256 hashes.
Sensitive or over-budget output fails closed or is minimized under an explicit redaction contract; raw unbounded output is never written.
The fingerprint is derived from command, selector, typed class, expected/observed failure IDs and normalized diagnostic hash.
The same current fingerprint increments repeat_count and routes to repeated-failure-fingerprint stop-loss at the declared threshold; a different fingerprint resets the family count.
Regression repair preflight records searched log roots, query/fingerprint, matched paths and hashes, or an explicit no-match result, all with authorizes empty.
Repair preflight rejects a proposal without the implementation source and at least one concrete callsite read with current hashes.
Every declared direct consumer, existing test and dependency closure path is explicit, repository-contained, current and hash-bound.
Every observed error ID maps to at least one evidence file first read after that error; reused prior evidence alone cannot close the error.
Existing test files are selected when present; creating a new test requires a typed no_existing_test_file result and searched roots.
A repair hypothesis without current failure, source, callsite and targeted-test bindings is classified speculative and blocked before production write.
Phase scope selects targeted PhaseA.Platform.Tests coverage and the relevant phase_a or phase_b smoke when the changed surface requires runtime evidence.
Protected Phase paths fail closed without explicit approval and remain outside this plan's implementation write set.
Failed RED, fingerprint, investigation and log-search evidence is append-only and prior generated history is never rewritten.
All new route, repair and observation artifacts carry authorizes empty; only the terminal plan predicate may publish implementation-complete and Acceptance remains external.
Validation confirms no writes under execution-plans/2026-08-06-toolchain-plan-delivery-loop-skill and its repeated-failure behavior remains compatible.
